newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordanian government says ready for unconditional talks with Islamic opposition group.
- An Iranian parliamentarian warns President-elect Khatami against ignoring Khamenei's sensitivities.
- Yemen's budget deficit expected to end this year.
- Britain supports Middle East and North Africa economic conference in Qatar.
- Al-Baraka Group launches Islamic banking activities in Lebanon.
